inviteLines.line: 🔔 The steeple RINGS — one clear note. The chapel doors swing wide. "Come. Be washed. Trauma, grief, the whole weight — laid down. The price is obedience, a little geas, nothing you'd miss." (Accept: heal 40 + cleanse. Refuse: no leash, but no washing.)
